name: AI Devcontainer
initializeCommand: mkdir -p "$HOME/.devcontainer" "$HOME/.local/share/opencode" && : > "$HOME/.devcontainer/empty-gradle.properties" && ( test -f "$HOME/.local/share/opencode/auth.json" || printf '{}' > "$HOME/.local/share/opencode/auth.json" ) && ( CRED=$(security find-generic-password -s 'Claude Code-credentials' -w 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$CRED" ] && mkdir -p "$HOME/.claude" && printf '%s' "$CRED" > "$HOME/.claude/.credentials.json" && chmod 600 "$HOME/.claude/.credentials.json" ) || true
postCreateCommand: git config --global core.autocrlf input && git config --global init.defaultBranch main && sudo chown $(id -u):$(id -g) "$HOME/.local" "$HOME/.local/share" "$HOME/.local/share/opencode"
